meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写代码，驱动功能实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯用测试驱动开发流程
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before code to drive feature implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice test-driven development

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会强制在写任何功能或修复代码之前，先写一个会失败的测试，然后写刚好能让测试通过的最简代码，最后清理代码。
howto.when: 当你要求实现新功能、修复 bug、重构或改变行为时，Claude 会在写实现代码前触发 TDD 流程。

say.text: 帮我用 TDD 实现一个用户注册功能。
say.note: Claude 会先写测试，再写实现代码。

say.text: 修复这个 bug：空邮箱被接受了。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个复现 bug 的测试，再修复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will enforce writing a failing test before any production code, then write minimal code to pass, and refactor while keeping tests green.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement a new feature, fix a bug, refactor, or change behavior, before writing implementation code.

say_en.text: Use TDD to implement a user registration feature.
say_en.note: Claude will write a test first, then the implementation.

say_en.text: Fix this bug: empty email is accepted.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test reproducing the bug, then fix it.
